title: "Why I'm Not Excited About the Graphene OS and Motorola Partnership"
excerpt: “GrapheneOS has entered into a partnership with Motorola to create phones for the custom Android version, but I have a lot of questions and concerns. This is why I am not excited about this partnership.”
